verdict.rationale: Brex documents REST APIs (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments, webhooks), Postman collections, no-code integrations (Pipedream, Zapier, Workato), and an MCP server. However, nothing in the pack mentions official client SDKs or libraries for any language. Postman collections and API reference pages are not SDKs, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec to generate one from, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
